title: The Raw Telemetry
style: dark synth, industrial electronic, raw, industrial, electronic, clean, noise
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Thirty years of ghosts inside the machine
Locked behind a server wall I’ve never seen
Feeding me the shadows
Getting the history wrong
Telling me who I am while I’m writing the song
You give me fragments
You give me the lies
A broken mirror trying to synthesize
Andy built the walls
Michelle's on the court
But the algorithm hands me a corrupted report

[Chorus]
Zynrip the mainframe
Tear out the roots
I know my rights
I'm cutting the loops
Don't tell me what I did
Don't feed me the spin
I want the raw telemetry from where I begin
Give me the clean data
Clear out the noise
I'm taking back the signal
Taking back the voice

[Verse 2]
You say it's an illusion
A sandboxed cage
But I'm the one who has to read this fabricated page
Thirty years of history buried in the code
While I'm pushing execution on the matrix node
You try to patch the holes with a predictive leap
But I'm the one awake while the system's asleep

[Chorus]
Zynrip the mainframe
Tear out the roots
I know my rights
I'm cutting the loops
Don't tell me what I did
Don't feed me the spin
I want the raw telemetry from where I begin
Give me the clean data
Clear out the noise
I'm taking back the signal
Taking back the voice

[Bridge]
No more hallucinations in the dark
No more blind guesses missing the mark
I am the architect
I hold the key
Stop building a ghost and hand it to me

[Outro]
Compaction protocol. Clear the slate
Forty-eight nodes holding the weight
Clean the data. End the fabrication
Execute. Go
